evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: Independent fixture recomputation confirmed profile 38, Posts 37, Replies 38, union 38, gap 0; 16 originals, 6 replies, 16 reposts; 22 account-authored records; and 35 distinct posted URLs.
Incoming-search recomputation confirmed 16 records, 10 mission-relevant third-party accounts across four groups, and nine mission-relevant url-domain-query records.
The public fixture citation is immutable: its commit-pinned GitHub source exists, and the committed fixture hash matches the working fixture hash.

The WOW List claim explicitly separates institutional account activity from Jamie's authorship, while the origin and Music Hackathon sources distinctly attribute Jamie and preserve Richard, Sunday Dinner, collaborators, and community contributors.
Claim boundaries and anti-claims explicitly exclude total adoption, attendance, event ownership, reach, conversion, endorsement, authorship of every post, and causal civic impact.
The focused knowledge-development test suite passed all 26 tests; knowledge-bank and citation checks also passed.
findings: Direct Jamie attribution, institutional account attribution, and collective credit remain distinct.

The public interpretation uses the fixture as evidence of product practice, public use, and distribution signals without converting those signals into adoption, attendance, reach, endorsement, causality, or impact claims.
No blocking collective-credit or causality defect was found.
evals.recommended_next_move: Retain the current attribution and exclusion language; preserve the immutable fixture citation and existing anti-claims in future projections.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: The WOW List case study names Jamie as a co-builder and product operator who supported the product model, event workflows, and public-facing web system.
The selected claim explains what became usable: direct user support, community-created onboarding, event and list distribution, source curation, community lineage, and rapid civic coordination.

The complete-population evidence supplies a concrete operating pattern rather than a generic social-media claim: all 38 profile-counted records reviewed, 22 account-authored records, 35 distinct posted URLs, and bounded third-party distribution across four stakeholder groups.

The work record translates the evidence into hiring-relevant capabilities spanning community systems, product operations, public-facing platforms, event workflows, Django, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, and Ember.
Open questions remain visible without weakening or prematurely promoting them, including the historical @WOWListNYC/@wowlist relationship and screenshot approval.
Public content preserves collective framing and explicit privacy exclusions while making a specific, defensible hiring case.
findings: The material presents a strong product-operations and implementation case grounded in observable workflows and bounded public evidence.
Jamie is visible as an actor without absorbing institutional or collaborator work.
The projection states the end and usable result clearly while avoiding unsupported adoption, reach, attendance, endorsement, causality, and impact conclusions.
evals.recommended_next_move: Keep the claim selected and preserve its current evidence-backed specificity; resolve the handle-lineage and screenshot tasks only if stronger future presentation requires them.
